We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About Mercor

Mercor is defining the future of work. We partner with leading AI labs and enterprises to provide the human intelligence essential to AI development.

Our vast talent network trains frontier AI models in the same way teachers teach students: by sharing knowledge, experience, and context that can't be captured in code alone. Today, more than 30,000 experts in our network collectively earn over $2 million a day.

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society.

Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our new San Francisco headquarters.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff of talent experience, you'll own the shared backend architecture that underpins every user journey for talent network at Mercor.

Mercor's products—talent matching, assessment, expert workflows—are growing faster than any single team can architect for. You'll define the technical direction of the systems they all depend on: core services, data models, APIs, and infrastructure patterns that must scale with a network of tens of thousands of experts and the demands of the world's leading AI labs. You'll set the standards that dozens of engineers build on, pay down the architectural decisions that no longer fit, and make the ones that will still be right three years from now.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management role. You'll write code, review the designs that matter most, and act as the connective tissue between product teams—partnering directly with engineering leadership to shape how the organization builds.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture of Mercor's shared backend systems—core services, data models, APIs, and cross-product infrastructure.

  • Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for backend architecture across the organization.

  • Design systems for scale, reliability, and evolvability, and lead the highest-stakes technical decisions and design reviews.

  • Identify and pay down architectural debt that slows product teams, and lead complex cross-team migrations.

  • Establish backend engineering standards, patterns, and best practices adopted across all product teams.

  • Stay hands-on: prototype critical systems, ship production code, and unblock teams on their hardest technical problems.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, platform investments, and technical hiring.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including 3+ years operating at a Senior level or above.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, service architecture, data modeling, and API design at scale.

  • A track record of owning architecture across multiple teams or an entire organization—and of decisions that aged well.

  • Experience leading large, complex technical migrations in production without stopping the business.

  • Strong opinions, loosely held: you drive alignment through technical judgment and clear writing, not authority.

  • Fluent in using modern AI development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to improve engineering productivity.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across an organization.

  • Excellent communication skills—able to make complex tradeoffs legible to both engineers and leadership.

  • High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

About the role

As a Healthcare Data Partnerships Associate, you'll help build out Mercor's data partnerships engine in healthcare. An integral part of our strategy is partnering with health systems, payers, EHR vendors, and other organizations that hold large, high-quality healthcare datasets to access new kinds of data at scale.

You'll be on the front lines of outbound — calling, emailing, and prospecting to build pipeline — while supporting deal-building and relationship management with a wide range of organizations. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who wants to learn hardcore sales and deal-making in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

What you'll do

  • Run high-volume outbound: calling, emailing, and prospecting to build and fill the partnership pipeline from scratch

  • Help identify and prioritize potential data partners: health systems, payers, EHR vendors, life sciences companies, and other organizations with large, structured healthcare datasets

  • Support the partnership cycle — outbound prospecting, pitch development, and deal coordination — alongside senior team members

  • Book meetings and manage an active outreach cadence across calls, email, and LinkedIn to keep pipeline moving

  • Help draft and organize materials for data licensing and data sharing agreements, including pricing, access terms, compliance requirements, and usage rights

  • Contribute to building repeatable outbound processes, playbooks, and tracking metrics for the partnerships function

  • Support ongoing partner relationships, helping with renewals, check-ins, and maintaining trust over time

  • Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and legal to support smooth data integration and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, de-identification, FHIR/HL7)

  • Help represent Mercor at digital health conferences and industry forums to build brand and relationships in the HLS ecosystem

  • Support market research and segmentation across provider, payer, BioPharma, and medical devices

What we're looking for

  • 2-4 years of experience in partnerships, BD, or sales, with real outbound / hardcore sales experience — you're not afraid of the phone

  • Track record of hitting outbound activity targets (calls, emails, meetings booked) in a fast-paced sales environment

  • Strong interest in healthcare data partnerships and eagerness to learn deal sourcing and negotiation

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with external stakeholders

  • Familiarity with or strong interest in data licensing, IP deal structures, or de-identification frameworks

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Within Mercor, our Enterprise AI organization builds the infrastructure enterprises need to deploy continuously improving production AI systems. Rather than relying on hand-written prompts and manual workflows, we help organizations translate how their best people work into agent behavior, evaluate outputs against measurable quality standards, and create feedback loops that make agents smarter over time.

Our platform combines organizational context, evaluation systems, and quality guardrails into a stack that powers accelerated AI deployment in weeks instead of months. Proven at scale with the world’s leading frontier AI labs, our technology now powers AI deployments across Fortune 500 organizations.

This full-time leadership role sits within Applied AI (the Forward Deployed Engineering team of our Enterprise AI organization) and operates separately from Mercor's expert network.

We're hiring Applied AI Leads to build and scale the technical delivery team responsible for deploying Mercor's Enterprise AI platform for enterprise customers.

This is a highly customer-facing engineering leadership role that is tightly integrated with our Sales/GTM and delivery teams. You’ll lead engineers in the end-to-end technical delivery of production-grade AI systems, working hand-in-hand with customer stakeholders to solve technically complex business problems and contributing to the overall commercial relationship with the customer.

Success is measured by customer outcomes and overall commercial impact, not individual code output. You'll own technical delivery, coach engineers, remove blockers, and ensure deployments are reliable, scalable, and customer-ready. You have a deep understanding of customer workflows, use case requirements, and acceptance criteria. While you’re expected to be technically credible and capable of hands-on contribution, your primary responsibility is enabling your engineering team to execute.

What You'll Do

  • Partner directly with customers to align technical requirements with business objectives, acting as the critical bridge between engineering and Sales, GTM, and delivery

  • Co-lead a Technical team with an Operations counterpart to deliver scalable, production-ready AI systems for enterprise customers

  • Translate ambiguous workflows into scalable AI-powered solutions, integrating across enterprise systems, APIs, internal tools, and data sources

  • Guide the deployment of AI workflows, agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and continual learning feedback loops

  • Hire, mentor, and develop exceptional engineers while establishing rigorous engineering and technical delivery practices as the organization scales

  • Work closely with Sales/GTM, Product, Research, and Platform Engineering to bring new AI capabilities into production

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building production software systems, with strong software engineering fundamentals in Python, Go, Java, Rust, or similar languages

  • 2+ years directly managing technical teams

  • Proven track record leading customer-facing technical delivery for enterprise software, AI products, or developer platforms

  • Deep experience designing designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications

  • Highly comfortable communicating complex technical concepts to both engineers and executive-level customer stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, coach others, make decisive technical calls, and maintain high execution velocity in unstructured environments

Nice to Haves

  • AI agents or agent orchestration

  • LLM applications

  • Evaluation systems or benchmarking

  • Enterprise integrations

  • Workflow automation

  • Production ML systems

Who Thrives Here

You enjoy solving ambiguous technical problems with customers, building high-performing teams, and shipping production systems that create measurable business value.

You are a technical delivery leader first, and an individual contributor second. Your instinct is to remove blockers, build deep trust with enterprise stakeholders, and partner closely with sales to ensure mutual success.

Why Join Mercor

  • Build production AI systems deployed for some of the world's largest enterprises

  • Help define how organizations adopt agentic AI at scale

  • Lead a high-impact, forward-deployed engineering organization from its earliest stages

  • Work alongside elite engineers, researchers, and operators at the forefront of enterprise

Benefits

  • Participation in the Enterprise revenue sharing pool

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

You’ll lead engineers in the end-to-end technical delivery of production-grade AI systems, working hand-in-hand with customer stakeholders to solve technically complex business problems and contributing to the overall commercial relationship with the customer.

Success is measured by customer outcomes and overall commercial impact, not individual code output. You'll own technical delivery, coach engineers, remove blockers, and ensure deployments are reliable, scalable, and customer-ready. You have a deep understanding of customer workflows, use case requirements, and acceptance criteria. While you’re expected to be technically credible and capable of hands-on contribution, your primary responsibility is enabling your engineering team to execute.

What You'll Do

 - Partner directly with customers to align technical requirements with business objectives, acting as the critical bridge between engineering and Sales, GTM, and delivery

 - Co-lead a Technical team with an Operations counterpart to deliver scalable, production-ready AI systems for enterprise customers

 - Translate ambiguous workflows into scalable AI-powered solutions, integrating across enterprise systems, APIs, internal tools, and data sources

 - Guide the deployment of AI workflows, agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and continual learning feedback loops

 - Hire, mentor, and develop exceptional engineers while establishing rigorous engineering and technical delivery practices as the organization scales

 - Work closely with Sales/GTM, Product, Research, and Platform Engineering to bring new AI capabilities into production

What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years building production software systems, with strong software engineering fundamentals in Python, Go, Java, Rust, or similar languages

 - 2+ years directly managing technical teams

 - Proven track record leading customer-facing technical delivery for enterprise software, AI products, or developer platforms

 - Deep experience designing designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications

 - Highly comfortable communicating complex technical concepts to both engineers and executive-level customer stakeholders

 - Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, coach others, make decisive technical calls, and maintain high execution velocity in unstructured environments

Nice to Haves

 - AI agents or agent orchestration

 - LLM applications

 - Evaluation systems or benchmarking

 - Enterprise integrations

 - Workflow automation

 - Production ML systems

You enjoy solving ambiguous technical problems with customers, building high-performing teams, and shipping production systems that create measurable business value.

You are a technical delivery leader first, and an individual contributor second. Your instinct is to remove blockers, build deep trust with enterprise stakeholders, and partner closely with sales to ensure mutual success.

Why Join Mercor

 - Build production AI systems deployed for some of the world's largest enterprises

 - Help define how organizations adopt agentic AI at scale

 - Lead a high-impact, forward-deployed engineering organization from its earliest stages

 - Work alongside elite engineers, researchers, and operators at the forefront of enterprise

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Data
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Frontier AI is going physical, and the labs building it are bottlenecked on one thing: high-quality data from the real world. Mercor pairs its operational scale with the specialized engineering that physical-world data demands.

You'll build the data backbone of physical AI: the pipelines that take raw multi-sensor capture from the field (video, depth, inertial, audio, and more) and turn it into validated, privacy-safe, delivery-ready datasets for frontier labs. Ingest, segmentation, pre-labeling, automated QC, and packaging, at petabyte scale across thousands of concurrent collectors.

What You'll Do

  • Build the end-to-end sensor data pipeline: ingest from capture devices in the field, through segmentation, pre-labeling, QC, and packaged delivery to customers

  • Design automated QC that validates recordings at scale: timing and sync integrity, calibration health, sensor continuity, coverage against requirements

  • Establish dataset schemas, versioning, provenance, and versioning, so every delivery has a clear system traceability

  • Build shared processing components such as privacy redaction, transcription, encoding, format packaging across all offerings

  • Integrate VLM-assisted pre-labeling and quality scoring into production workflows without sacrificing debuggability or human oversight

What Makes This Role Different

  • High ownership, early. This is a young, strategically central product area; the product you build will shape Mercor’s physical-world data collection standards

  • The data is the deliverable. The end product at Mercor is the data; what your pipeline produces is what shapes the models that large frontier lab trains on

  • Real physical-world scale. Your inputs come from devices operated by humans in global real world settings, for thousands of hours. Building systems that scale is precedent.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong production backend/data engineering experience — you've built and owned high-volume data pipelines

  • Experience processing video or sensor data at scale: large binary formats, streaming ingestion, distributed batch processing, object storage economics

  • Fluency in Python and comfortable with AWS

  • Genuine data taste: you can look at a sensor trace or a timing histogram and tell when something is off

  • Comfort in ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces where requirements evolve with the customer

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics data formats and tooling (MCAP, ROS bags, protobuf, Foxglove), camera geometry, or multi-sensor calibration and synchronization

  • Computer vision or multimodal ML experience (detection, tracking, VLM-based labeling or QC)

  • Prior work on data engines for AV, robotics, or egocentric video

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.title: Procurement Operations Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Mercor is bringing on our first dedicated Procurement Operations hire to build our intake-to-PO infrastructure from the ground up. This is a high-impact, foundational role reporting to our Head of Procurement: you won't be running existing systems, you'll be designing and optimizing them on our current platforms — and then owning how they run day to day. You'll work at the intersection of Finance, Legal, Security, and Engineering, with direct exposure to how the business scales. If you like building order out of ambiguity and want your work directly tied to company growth, this is the role.


What You'll Do

  • Build and Own the Intake-to-PO Lifecycle: Design and launch our intake-to-procure process — intake triage, approval matrices, vendor onboarding, PO creation, and fast-buy paths like P-card programs, catalogs, and self-service purchasing — then run it day-to-day, identifying bottlenecks and driving issues to resolution with minimal oversight across business, finance, legal, security, and IT.

  • Re-architect Procurement with AI: Identify where AI agents, automation, and modern tooling can replace manual work, then build, deploy, and iterate. Verify AI output with rigor — anticipate failure modes, build in checks, and set the standard for how the team distinguishes trustworthy output from unreliable work.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable: Support vendor master data quality and PO accuracy, and help troubleshoot disputes upstream before they become an AP problem.

  • Be the Subject-Matter Expert: Provide clear, responsive guidance to stakeholders and vendors on procurement tools, policy, and compliance. Exercise sound business judgment on exceptions, and create and maintain training materials and knowledge-base content so process knowledge scales beyond you.

  • Metrics & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track procurement performance, surface trends and anomalies, and translate data into a clear narrative for leadership.

  • Cross-Functional Change Management: Lead or support change efforts tied to new processes and tooling, and represent Procurement in cross-functional initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 4-8 years of experience in procurement operations, intake-to-PO processes, or an analytically rigorous operations role at a high-growth tech company.

  • Direct experience building procurement processes from zero — intake, approval matrices, vendor onboarding — not just operating within one that already exists.

  • Deep familiarity with procurement/P2P tooling (e.g. Ramp, Ironclad, Zip, or similar) and a bias toward automation over manual work.

  • Comfort building with and evaluating AI tools and agents, with the rigor to verify their output rather than take it at face value.

  • Working knowledge of AP and payment processes, so you can hand off cleanly to AP and troubleshoot upstream issues before they become AP's problem.

  • Strong business judgment — comfortable resolving exceptions, managing ambiguity, and making calls without a rulebook already written for you.

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather design the scalable system than repeatedly patch the same manual process.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication — you can explain policy and process clearly to both internal teams and vendors.

  • Can-do attitude!

Compensation

  • Base cash comp from $160k-$220k

  • Offers Bonus

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the role:

Enterprise evals is one of Mercor's top priorities and one of the largest new markets in AI. The frontier labs already run evals to build their models. As companies put AI agents into real work, they will need to run evals too. Mercor is building a new eval business unit to lead that market.

You'll be the first dedicated marketer on evals - from positioning and planning campaigns to executing across all areas of marketing. You'll partner with research and GTM to understand the buyer and run campaigns across paid, email, social, and organic.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Own marketing for Evals end to end, building a roadmap around high-impact programs.

  • Define lifecycle stages, track performance, and optimize to drive pipeline and revenue efficiently.

  • Build and run integrated campaigns across paid, email, social, and organic that bring in leads.

  • Own positioning and messaging for the evals product in collaboration with research and product.

  • Bring an AI-first approach to the whole workflow: campaign launches, optimization, content at scale, and reporting.

  • Run the role like an owner. Build a roadmap around a few high-impact programs.

 

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years in B2B marketing, with hands-on work across more than one area (demand gen, product marketing, content, events). The title is flexible depending on experience.

  • Depth in one or two of those areas and fluency across the rest. You can do the work yourself and you know what good looks like everywhere else.

  • Built or scaled marketing at a Series B or C hypergrowth company, not just a large tech company. You've been on a small, early team and can flex across functions.

  • A track record of cross-channel campaigns that moved pipeline.

  • Fluent with AI and modern marketing tools for research, content, campaigns, and automation.

  • You understand the speed of AI companies and can build modern demand programs to match the pace expected.

  • An exceptional writer and editor with a high bar for quality and examples to prove it.

     

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity (aligned with a venture-backed, rapidly scaling AI company)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry/housekeeping reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Product Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, GTM, and our customers - the world's leading AI labs. You'll help grow Mercor's most strategic accounts by scoping complex AI data projects during the sales process, developing the technical strategy behind account growth plans, and ensuring every committed project is set up to deliver.

As part of our Applied AI team, you'll own technical scoping upstream of commitment - turning ambiguous customer requests into sized, deliverable projects and serving as the voice of the customer inside the Product organization. You'll also own the roadmap for customer integrations and the processes that make delivery measurably more reliable with every cycle.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing role in the Product Management job family for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with strategic customers, and building systems that scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Scope Customer Solutions: Partner with GTM and customers during the pre-sales process to scope complex AI data projects. Define technical requirements, break down and size the engineering effort, identify the ROI for each project.

  • Drive Account Growth: Work directly with AI researchers at leading labs and internal GTM leads to formulate and execute account growth plans. Leverage Mercor's evaluation infrastructure and data inventory to generate new demand, and track the competitive landscape to position Mercor to win.

  • Lead Customer Implementations: Assemble the right solution for every committed project - composing the teams, resources, and bandwidth it will take to deliver - and coordinate across Product, Engineering, GTM, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful launches.

  • Own Customer Integrations: Set the roadmap for integrations with customer platforms and data systems, expanding the integration surfaces that unblock new revenue and driving toward seamless, reliable delivery regardless of customer infrastructure.

  • Make Delivery Reliable: Lead delivery incident response and root-cause analysis, triage technical blockers to the right owners, and track corrective actions to resolution so the same issue never recurs.

  • Shape The Product: Identify recurring customer needs and translate them into product requirements. Own the roadmap for customer integrations and partner with Engineering to expand platform capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in Product Management, Technical Program Management, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Implementation Consulting, or a similar technical, customer-facing role.

  • Technical Fluency: Familiar with coding agents. Comfortable using SQL/Python without agent assistance as well. Can break down large engineering problems into well-scoped roadmaps. Able to hold your own in technical conversations with AI researchers and engineers.

  • Ownership: Thrive in ambiguous environments and take ownership from problem definition through execution. Customer-focused with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Commercial Judgment: Comfortable weighing revenue upside against delivery cost, and spotting the account opportunities others miss.

  • Systems Thinking: Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills. Passion for fixing problems at the source and building repeatable systems rather than one-off solutions.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Mercor is building its first mobile app, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it end to end. The app will be how experts apply for jobs on Mercor, track their contracts, and complete assessments, all from their phone. This is a brand-new surface, and you'll be the person who takes it from 0-1.

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced mobile focused PM. You get the blank canvas of a greenfield product with the built-in network and scale of a platform that already creates hundreds of thousands of jobs and pays out over $4 million a day. You'll shape the future of expert interaction with Mercor, and will own Mercor’s mobile strategy and validate the impact of marginal mobile users and usage.

What You’ll Do

  • Launch the mobile surface: Take Mercor's mobile app from concept to launch and beyond defining what it is, what it isn't, and what it becomes. This will start with the roadmap for how experts apply to jobs, track contracts, and submit assessments on mobile.

  • Own the full lifecycle: Drive the product end-to-end, from conception through launch and iteration, including release management, app store operations, mobile analytics and instrumentation, and post-launch growth.

  • Advance the frontier of AI: Mercor is organizing humanity's expertise into better AI models for every lab and enterprise. You'll build and own the products that make this possible.

  • Understand the Business: Work backwards from business outcomes to make product decisions that impact business health and growth.

  • Get in the weeds: Write specs and PRDs but also build dashboards and make small PRs to unblock yourself.

What We’re Looking For

  • Mobile launch experience: You've shipped and scaled mobile apps before. You know what it takes to build native experiences, manage app store releases and review cycles, and grow a mobile product from zero to meaningful adoption.

  • Proven 0-to-1 track record: You've built and launched at least one product from scratch, and you're energized by a greenfield mandate with no existing playbook.

  • Experience: 5+ years as a product manager, with significant time spent on mobile products.

  • High Ownership: You take full accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.

  • Independence: Able to self-direct in ambiguous contexts, creating clarity for others.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable building scrappy MVPs yourself when needed to validate direction, unblock engineering, or accelerate iteration.

  • Strategic Vision: Strong ability to connect user needs and business context to long-term product direction.

  • User Obsession and Understanding: Talks to users frequently, knows how to effectively conduct user research and customer interviews.

  • Balance of Metrics & Vision: Equally comfortable running rigorous experiments and pushing forward visionary bets.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff of talent experience, you'll own the shared backend architecture that underpins every user journey for talent network at Mercor.

Mercor's products—talent matching, assessment, expert workflows—are growing faster than any single team can architect for. You'll define the technical direction of the systems they all depend on: core services, data models, APIs, and infrastructure patterns that must scale with a network of tens of thousands of experts and the demands of the world's leading AI labs. You'll set the standards that dozens of engineers build on, pay down the architectural decisions that no longer fit, and make the ones that will still be right three years from now.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management role. You'll write code, review the designs that matter most, and act as the connective tissue between product teams—partnering directly with engineering leadership to shape how the organization builds.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of Mercor's shared backend systems—core services, data models, APIs, and cross-product infrastructure.

  • Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for backend architecture across the organization.

  • Design systems for scale, reliability, and evolvability, and lead the highest-stakes technical decisions and design reviews.

  • Identify and pay down architectural debt that slows product teams, and lead complex cross-team migrations.

  • Establish backend engineering standards, patterns, and best practices adopted across all product teams.

  • Stay hands-on: prototype critical systems, ship production code, and unblock teams on their hardest technical problems.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, platform investments, and technical hiring.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including 3+ years operating at a Senior level or above.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, service architecture, data modeling, and API design at scale.

  • A track record of owning architecture across multiple teams or an entire organization—and of decisions that aged well.

  • Experience leading large, complex technical migrations in production without stopping the business.

  • Strong opinions, loosely held: you drive alignment through technical judgment and clear writing, not authority.

  • Fluent in using modern AI development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to improve engineering productivity.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across an organization.

  • Excellent communication skills—able to make complex tradeoffs legible to both engineers and leadership.

  • High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping.

Why Mercor

  • Impact: Own the architecture that every Mercor product is built on, at a company scaling faster than almost any in its category.

  • Ownership: Organization-wide technical scope with a direct line to engineering leadership and real authority over technical direction.

  • Learning: Work alongside world-class engineers, product leaders, and AI researchers building products at the frontier of AI.

  • Growth: Shape the engineering organization itself—its standards, its architecture, and its next generation of technical leaders.

Benefits

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • A $20K relocation bonus (if moving to the Bay Area)

  • A $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • A $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • Health insurance

Partnering closely with Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations, you’ll help the business adopt new technologies quickly, negotiate commercial frameworks that scale with our growth, and ensure our supplier ecosystem is a competitive advantage.

Your work will directly influence how quickly Mercor can adopt new technologies, scale its AI platform and expert network, and build durable commercial advantages.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end sourcing and commercial negotiations across software, AI, cloud, infrastructure, security, developer tools, and business services.

  • Partner with stakeholders across Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, Legal, IT, and Operations to deliver commercial outcomes that enable the business to move quickly and scale efficiently.

  • Structure commercial agreements that balance speed, flexibility, cost, and long-term business value.

  • Independently negotiate agreements ranging from tactical purchases to $1M+ strategic vendor relationships.

  • Own competitive sourcing events, pricing strategy, contract negotiations, renewals, and supplier relationships.

  • Provide market insights and commercial guidance to influence vendor and investment decisions.

  • Help build scalable procurement processes that enable growth without creating friction.

What We're Looking For

You'll partner directly with leadership to turn revenue targets into hiring plans, and you'll understand what makes a great Account Executive or Data Partnerships Lead as well as you understand Mercor's product. This is a 0→1 motion for GTM recruiting specifically - you're building the playbook, not inheriting one.

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Mercor's GTM organization: Sales, Partnerships/BD, and Growth with occasional support across Operations and other business functions as priorities shift

  • Assess for what GTM roles actually require: quota attainment, deal-cycle ownership, territory/segment fluency, and consultative selling

  • Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor's own product (structured screens, automated work samples, calibrated rubrics)

  • Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene specific to revenue roles

  • Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize funnel metrics by role and segment

  • Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for fast decisions, fast offers, and a candidate experience that holds up in a highly competitive GTM talent market

  • Represent Mercor externally as a face of the brand in a market where AI labs and top startups are all competing for the same GTM talent

  • Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Hex and other recruiting systems

What We're Looking For

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience specifically for GTM roles - Account Executives, Data Acquisition, Growth and GTM Associates

  • Fluency in what makes a GTM hire strong: market research and account prospecting, deal-cycle and territory dynamics, consultative vs. transactional sales motions

  • Proven ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

  • High motor, outcome-oriented approach; Mercor is in hypergrowth, and GTM hiring is a direct driver of revenue growth

  • Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with GTM leadership, Account Leads, and internal cross functional partners

  • Confident representing the Mercor brand to top GTM candidates in a competitive market

  • Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting for AI, SaaS or enterprise software companies

  • Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

  • Interest in the human data / AGI space

  • Comfort with shifting hiring demands; support for Operations, Strategy, or other business functions as Mercor's needs evolve

Ideal Qualities

  • Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

  • Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

  • Growth Mindset - You don't need to be an expert on AI, but you do need a strong desire to learn in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

  • Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold yourself accountable to an extremely high standard of work

  • Love for the Craft - genuine enthusiasm for building a best-in-class GTM talent acquisition motion, not just recruiting operations

Benefits

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Up to $15K in relocation assistance (for moving to the Bay Area)

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As a Talent Intelligence & Analytics Manager at Mercor, you'll be the person who knows the AI talent market better than anyone else on the team: where competitors are finding talent, how compensation is trending, and what it actually takes to win a candidate in this market. You'll build the data and research layer underneath all of Mercor's recruiting - GTM, Applied AI, Operations, and beyond - turning market signal and funnel data into decisions our recruiters and leadership can act on.

What You'll Do

  • Track the competitive AI talent landscape: where frontier labs, Mag 7 companies, and direct competitors are sourcing talent, how their teams are structured, and how they're positioning offers

  • Analyze Mercor's own hiring funnel: pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield, and quality of hire, and turn that into recommendations recruiters and leadership can act on

  • Build dashboards and reporting that give recruiting leadership a real-time read on pipeline health and hiring capacity

  • Act as the analytics expert for Talent Acquisition, informing strategic decision making across the recruiting funnel

  • Partner with business leadership as well as recruiters across GTM, Applied AI, and Operations to answer their specific market and pipeline questions

  • Run research projects on talent-market trends: where the best AI talent is coming from, how compensation structures are evolving, and what's changing in how competitors hire

  • Build and maintain compensation benchmarking across roles and markets, keeping Mercor's offers competitive as the AI talent market shifts

  • Present findings directly to recruiting and company leadership, translating data into a clear point of view

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in people analytics, talent intelligence, or recruiting analytics, ideally at a high-growth tech or AI company

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills; comfort building dashboards in tools like Hex, Looker, or Tableau

  • A genuine interest in the AI talent market: who's hiring, where they're finding people, how comp is trending, and what that means for Mercor's competitiveness

  • Ability to turn messy data into a clear narrative and a clear recommendation, not just a report

  • Strong communication skills; able to present data-backed points of view to recruiters and leadership with confidence

  • High motor, outcome-oriented approach; Mercor is in hypergrowth, and this role's insights directly shape hiring decisions across the company

  • Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in a strategy, market research, or competitive intelligence role prior to moving into talent/people analytics

  • Interest in the human data / AGI space

  • Experience building compensation benchmarking models or market-pay studies

  • Comfort supporting multiple recruiting functions (GTM, Applied AI, Operations) at once

Ideal Qualities

  • Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

  • Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

  • Growth Mindset - You don't need to be an expert on AI, but you do need a strong desire to learn in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

  • Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold yourself accountable to an extremely high standard of work

  • Love for the Craft - genuine enthusiasm for building a best-in-class talent function

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

This is a rare, foundational hire: Mercor's first GTM Engineer. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, growth, and marketing — building the systems that power how Mercor acquires, serves, and expands customers.

You'll design and deploy the infrastructure behind Mercor's go-to-market engine from the ground up: integrating AI agents into customer workflows, building the data and tooling to power marketing and sales, and transforming manual, spreadsheet-driven processes into reliable, production-grade systems.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with exceptional business instincts. You understand how modern go-to-market organizations actually operate — from lead generation and attribution to pipeline management and customer expansion — and have the technical fluency to turn that understanding into scalable systems. You're equally comfortable writing SQL and Python, building AI-powered workflows, and partnering with marketing and revenue leaders to solve high-leverage operational problems.

What You'll Do

GTM Data & Systems

  • Design, build, and maintain the data and automation infrastructure that powers Mercor's go-to-market organization, spanning marketing, sales, customer success, and operations including account & contact enrichment, and outbound and email tooling

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Revenue, Operations, and Engineering to translate business requirements into scalable data models, workflows, and technical systems

  • Build and maintain reliable integrations across Mercor's GTM stack (Attio, Customer.io, Clay), ensuring customer, pipeline, and product data remain accurate and accessible

  • Develop dashboards, experimentation frameworks, and self-serve reporting that give GTM leaders real-time visibility into pipeline, conversion, attribution, and revenue performance

  • Own the quality, documentation, and governance of GTM data so teams can make decisions with confidence

AI & Automation

  • Build AI agents that automate lead research, enrichment, routing, campaign execution, outbound personalization, customer intelligence, and other high-impact workflows

  • Deploy production-grade automations using frontier language models, APIs, workflow orchestration, and modern data infrastructure to eliminate manual operational work

  • Rapidly prototype AI-powered workflows, measure their business impact, and scale successful experiments into core GTM infrastructure

  • Stay at the frontier of AI tooling and proactively introduce new capabilities that increase the leverage of Mercor's go-to-market teams

Scale & Operations

  • Build reliable, observable data pipelines and workflows that customer-facing teams depend on every day

  • Continuously identify operational bottlenecks and automate repetitive processes across the customer lifecycle

  • Improve TAM mapping, account and contact enrichment, rules of engagement, attribution, and lead routing — giving decentralized GTM teams a shared view of prospects and customers and coordinating engagement across Mercor's products

  • Champion a culture of data quality, documentation, and rapid iteration across Mercor's go-to-market organization

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, data science, growth engineering, revenue operations, or a similarly technical role with a track record of building reliable systems in high-growth environments

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. While you can learn new tools on the job, we expect excellent technical fundamentals and the ability to work across modern data and AI infrastructure

  • Experience building data pipelines, integrating APIs, and designing reliable workflows across business systems

  • Strong intuition for go-to-market operations — you understand how marketing, sales, and customer success organizations operate, and can translate business problems into scalable technical solutions

  • Experience working with modern data warehouses, orchestration tools, and BI platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, Looker, Hex, or similar)

  • A builder's instinct: you take ownership of ambiguous problems, move quickly, and know when to build for speed versus long-term scale

  • Excellent communication skills — you can partner effectively with marketing, revenue, operations, and engineering teams to solve high-impact business problems

  • Experience thriving in fast-moving, high-growth environments

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base cash compensation from $175K – $250K

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

As a Product Operations Manager on the Talent Experience team, you'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and the experts who do the work on Mercor's platform. You'll help experts succeed by running the feedback loop that turns their problems into product changes, owning the tooling and data our specialists work in, and working through the distributed team that is the front line of that loop.

You'll own the operational systems that make expert support work at scale - from the tool stack and reporting layer to the cross-functional channels that route each problem to the team that owns it - while serving as the voice of experts inside the Product organization. You'll also own how the work gets done across the team: the processes, the quality bar, and the operating cadence that keep it consistent as scope grows.

This is a hands-on, systems-building role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working close to the people our platform serves, and fixing the process that produced ten tickets rather than closing the ten tickets.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the expert feedback loop: Collect signal from satisfaction surveys, support conversations, and agent transcripts. Categorize it by driver and account, prioritize by volume and severity, get it in front of the people who can act on it, and close the loop back to experts so they know it landed.

  • Turn support signal into product requirements: Be the channel between the people who talk to experts every day and the people who build for them. Make sure a recurring failure becomes a roadmap item rather than a standing workaround.

  • Own the data layer for expert experience: Enforce data quality, and make sure the team can get to numbers without waiting on an analyst. Report what moved and why, not just the number.

  • Run and improve the tool stack: Select, integrate, and administer the tools the team works in - support platform, AI agents, internal admin surfaces, reporting. Measure whether they are actually being used, train the team on them, and retire what isn't earning its place.

  • Enable the team to run experiments: Set up the data and tooling to test hypotheses across the expert lifecycle - onboarding friction, comms nudges, assessment drop-off - so we change things on evidence and can tell afterward whether it worked.

  • Drive the Talent Success operation: Work day to day with the distributed team of account-aligned specialists who cover our largest accounts. Set the operating cadence, hold the quality bar, and own the throughput of the support queues as scope grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Support or CX exposure, Implementation Consulting, or a similar operational role. Experience working or coordinating distributed teams is a strong plus.

  • Technical Fluency: Familiar with coding agents. Comfortable using SQL without agent assistance.

  • Ownership: Thrive in ambiguous environments and take ownership from problem definition through execution. Expert-focused, with excellent written and verbal communication - much of this job is making a cross-functional owner care about a problem that isn't theirs yet.

  • Systems Thinking: Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills. Passion for building repeatable systems rather than one-off solutions, and for fixing problems at the source.

  • Working Through Others: Comfortable operating across a distributed team spanning time zones - setting a bar, giving direct feedback, and getting things done through people who don't report to you.

Location

San Francisco (in-office).

Benefits

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

About the Role

As a Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle hiring for critical roles across a range of organizations, with a particular focus on Member of Technical Staff roles. You'll report to Deeptune's Head of Talent and partner with hiring managers to translate ambiguous needs into clear search strategies.

We're looking for an NYC-based talent hire to join us five days a week at our new office in the heart of the Financial District. This is a high-ownership role for someone with strong agency, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and able to build processes that hold up under pressure.

You'll work directly with General Managers to identify high performers who go on to support the world's leading AI labs and play an instrumental role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies. This is a true 0→1 motion and an opportunity to lay the foundation for the future of recruiting at Mercor.

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting (sourcing → close) across a variety of organizations (such as marketing, finance, people ops, with a prominent focus on operations)

  • Partner with b to map out needs and implement continual process improvements

  • Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor's own product (structured screens, automated work samples, and calibrated rubrics)

  • Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene

  • Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize key funnel metrics (pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield)

  • Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for same-day debriefs, fast offers, and strong candidate experience

  • Build brand: campaigns, referrals, and events that attract top engineers and operators.

  • Represent Deeptune and Mercor externally; you'll be a face of the brand for an exceptionally competitive talent market.

  • Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Ashby and other recruiting systems.

  • Refinement of technical recruiting motion as the Ops org shifts to hire more frequently from technical backgrounds

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with full-cycle recruiting across IC and leadership roles

  • Proven ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

  • High motor, outcome-oriented approach; Mercor is in hypergrowth, and hiring is viewed as a key strategic driver of that growth

  • Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with General Managers, Account Leads, and internal leadership

  • Familiarity with a range of roles, emphasis on GTM, Strategy, Operations, ideally with some mastery of technical roles such as SWEs or FDEs

  • Confident representing the Deeptune and Mercor brand to top candidates

  • Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems

Nice to Haves

  • Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

  • Interest in the human data / AGI space

  • Technical recruiting expertise - Mercor's business is trending in an increasingly technical perspective over time, and we are hiring a greater percentage of technical professionals into client-facing operator roles

Ideal Qualities

  • Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

  • Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

  • Growth Mindset - You don't need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

  • Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

  • Love for the Craft - we are building a zero-to-one motion; this hire will bring a low-ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition motion

Benefits

  • $15K relocation bonus (for moving to the New York metropolitan area)

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Deeptune Environments
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About Deeptune

Deeptune is an RL environments lab within Mercor. We build training gyms for AI agents — high-fidelity simulations where models learn to solve economically valuable problems through reinforcement learning. We work with the leading AI labs to train the next generation of agentic models, and our environments have already contributed to recent breakthroughs in computer use, code generation, and multi-step task completion.

About the Role

This is a backend and infrastructure role, not a research or model-training role.

You'll build the systems our environments run on: sandboxed execution, orchestration for thousands of concurrent rollouts, agent and task harnesses, tool APIs, the grading layer that decides whether an agent actually succeeded, and the pipelines that turn raw human demonstrations into training-ready environments.

You'll do this alongside researchers who own the RL side. Your job is to make their ideas real: fast, correct, and reliable at scale. That means you should know enough about post-training, evals, and reward modeling to push back on a research spec productively. It does not mean you'll be training models.

The work is high-ownership and lightly specified. You'll set direction, drive outcomes, and stay hands-on. You'll also work directly with AI labs and enterprise partners, which means shipping against real external deadlines rather than internal ones.

What You'll Do

  • Build the systems that build environments end to end: the simulated app or system, the agent-facing tool surface, the task definitions, and the verifiers that score them.

  • Design and operate the infrastructure that runs environments at scale: containers, sandboxing, orchestration, queues, observability

  • Turn messy human data into clean, reproducible training environments.

  • A non-deterministic or slow environment is worse than no environment

  • Own the interface with labs and researchers: translate a research goal into a system that exists next week.

What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've built than how long you've been building it.

  • 2+ years of production backend engineering, including at least 1 year at a startup, ideally as a founding engineer, an early engineer at a fast-growing venture, or a founder yourself

  • Strong generalist with systems depth. We primarily use Python and seek engineers who are fluent in at least one language. Ideally, they should be skilled at applying agents with discernment and able to adapt quickly to different problem requirements.

  • Understanding of ML/LLM concepts. Post-training, evaluation metrics, reward modeling: deep enough to partner with researchers and execute on novel RL environments.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. You scope your own work, make pragmatic calls, and ship without a spec handed to you.

  • Ability to raise the bar around you. Coaching engineers and driving execution, while staying in the code

Bonus, not required: sandboxing or virtualization, browser and computer-use automation, CI/build systems, developer tooling.

You're a Match If

  • Ownership, impact, and building frontier tech are what motivate you

  • Your work is a craft you want to master

  • You thrive in ambiguity and like hard problems

  • You appreciate diverse perspectives and uncommon ideas

  • You're excited to build in person, 5 days a week, 10 am–8 pm ET, from our office at One World Trade

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

Trust is the foundation of Mercor's marketplace. With hundreds of thousands of experts applying for jobs and over $XX million paid out every day, the integrity of who's on the platform and how they work directly determines the quality of the data we deliver to every lab and enterprise. Defending against adversarial, fast-moving threats is one of the highest-leverage problems at the company.

You'll own the fraud detection and enforcement product and policies end to end: the multi-agent system that scores risk across expert lifecycle stages; the signals that feed it; and the enforcement actions. You'll also own the operational edge of trust and safety, designing the workflows reviewers live in, developing the governing policies, and closing the loop between what we catch in production and what we build next.

Partner with engineering, data science, operations, legal, and GTM, and move fluidly between building operational systems, analyzing model changes and whether they actually improved business outcomes, and working directly with strategic customers.

This is a technical, customer-facing role for someone who is energized by problems with no fixed playbook, who cares about both the system and the humans operating it, and who wants to own a product area where the stakes and the impact are unusually hig

What You’ll Do

  • Work backwards from the business: Connect Trust and Safety decisions to Mercor long term health, expert trust, and client trust, and use that to prioritize business outcomes

  • Own the Trust and Safety product end-to-end: Set the roadmap for Mercor's Trust and Safety systems and own the lifecycle from signal detection to enforcement action.

  • Improve Detection quality: Work with data science and engineering to tune models, prompts, and signals against real caseloads driving down false positive rates while holding the line on false negatives and expand automated decisioning as accuracy improves.

  • Build the Operations Tooling: Design the products and workflows that our operations analysts use every day. Orient them around the action being taken, keep evidence bars and audit trails clear, and make high-severity calls defensible.

  • Get in the weeds: Write specs and PRDs, but also build dashboards, pull SQL, and make small PRs to unblock yourself and validate direction.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Trust & Safety, Risk, Fraud, or a similar technical, operationally-minded role. Prior exposure to safety or integrity problems is a strong plus.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable with large datasets, AI agents, unblocking and accelerating engineering. Able to reason about how detection models and signals behave, and to hold your own in technical conversations with engineers and data scientists

  • Systems Thinking: A passion for building repeatable systems and fixing problems that span across multiple systems. Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills.

  • Ownership: Thrive in ambiguous, adversarial environments and take ownership from problem definition through execution. High accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.

  • Judgment: Comfortable weighing the cost of a false positive against a missed fraud case, and making the tradeoffs explicit and consistent.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

Because what you build is used in-house and demoed to customers, it has to be both genuinely powerful and demo-ready polished.

This is a role for someone who cares equally about engineering craft and product impact: shipping scalable, reliable systems and intuitive interfaces that make everyone who touches the platform faster and more effective.

YOU WILL

- Own the agent platform across the full stack — from the internal- and client-facing React interfaces to the backend APIs and services orchestrating agents, workflows, and integrations.

- Enable hundreds of internal users and dozens of enterprise clients — ship the features, reliability, and polish that make the platform their daily driver and a confident live demo.

- Build the foundational layer other teams depend on to stand up new agent use cases, task formats, and client configurations quickly and without rework.

- Ship high-leverage product features that raise both internal productivity and the customer-facing quality of the platform.

- Translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped technical solutions through close collaboration with Applied AI researchers, product, design, and operations.

- Deep proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (React + Next.js) and a strong grasp of frontend architecture, state management, and design patterns.

- Strong design sense and empathy for end-users; you hold a high bar for usability.

- Experience with complex, high-throughput systems — pipelines, large data volumes, or multi-tenant architectures.

- High ownership mindset; able to navigate ambiguity and drive projects from design through delivery.

- Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and product tradeoffs clearly.

- Experience building agent frameworks, LLM-powered products, or human-in-the-loop AI workflows.

- Background in design systems, developer-facing APIs, or internal platform engineering.

- Exposure to AI tools, real-time data, or data visualization.

- Experience at top-tier tech companies or fast-scaling startups.

- The systems you ship will be used daily by hundreds of internal users and dozens of enterprise clients.

- Your work directly shapes both how Mercor works and how customers experience us.

- Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

- $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

- Free Equinox membership
